about.title: Built for health stress and everyday calm
about.body: CalmIq helps individuals manage health-related stress: soothing check-ins, simple calm routines, and recovery-comfort ideas (rest, pacing, gentle self-massage or actuator-style comfort guidance). Chat is a companion, not a clinic — when hands-on care matters, Calm+ members can request a physiotherapist session.
about.disclaimer: CalmIq does not diagnose, treat, or replace professional medical advice. Seek urgent care for severe or sudden symptoms.

legal.privacyBody: CalmIq stores account, subscription, and session-request data to deliver the product. Chat may be processed by our AI provider. Do not share sensitive medical identifiers you are not comfortable storing.
legal.termsBody: CalmIq chat is educational stress and wellbeing guidance, not diagnosis or emergency care. Physiotherapist sessions are fulfilled by humans after a paid Calm+ request. Use of the service constitutes acceptance of these terms.
